meta.title: ASSETRA Private Investors | Private-market opportunities for qualified investors
meta.description: A private investment club for investors with €100,000+ in capital. Access to selected private-credit, real-estate co-investment and off-market opportunities in Slovakia and Czechia.

hero.label: Private investment club
hero.title: ASSETRA Private Investors.
hero.subtitle: Private-market opportunities for investors with €100,000+ in capital.

intro: Membership is intended for investors planning to allocate at least €100,000 to private markets over the next 24 months. Members invest alongside ASSETRA and its partners in selected private-credit, real-estate and business-acquisition transactions in Slovakia and Czechia. Membership is not automatic — every application is reviewed individually.

privateCredit.title: 01 — Private Credit
privateCredit.text: Participation in selected real-estate financings, secured by a mortgage over property at a conservative LTV.

coInvest.title: 02 — Real Estate Co-Invest
coInvest.text: Joint participation in specific transactions — undervalued properties and development projects we invest in alongside you.

offMarket.title: 03 — Off-Market Opportunities
offMarket.text: Investment properties and acquisitions of operating businesses sourced outside the open market — below market price or with attractive yield.

memos.title: 04 — Investment Memos
memos.text: Every opportunity comes with an analysis: transaction, collateral, valuation, risks and downside scenario. No marketing brochures.

process.heading: How we select opportunities
process.note: Only a fraction of the opportunities we review reaches members. We show process and risk management, not return promises.

form.heading: Membership application
form.title: ASSETRA Investor Application
form.description: Membership is free, but selective. Based on your application we assess whether we can bring you relevant opportunities. Selected applicants are invited to a short introductory investor call.
form.allocation: How much capital do you plan to allocate to private markets over the next 24 months? *
form.assets: Approximate value of your investable assets *
form.ticket: Typical size of a single investment *
form.interests: Which opportunities are you interested in? *

consent: I consent to the processing of my personal data for the purpose of assessing my membership application and receiving investment opportunities, in line with the privacy policy. You can unsubscribe at any time.

success.title: Application received
success.text: Thank you. We will review your application and invite selected applicants to a short introductory investor call.
